title: The Drifting Boundary
logline: A veteran surveyor discovers a commercial navigation beacon has drifted for decades, slowly handing an independent asteroid claim over to a mining consortium.

roles.description: A veteran orbital surveyor who mapped the system boundaries thirty years ago; stiff, methodical, refuses to alter his ledger.
The local land registry representative; polite, underfunded, terrified of an open legal challenge.
A heavy gunboat registered to private extraction security, loitering along the disputed claim perimeter.
The primary commercial mineral holding company in the sector, aggressively absorbing unclaimed periphery veins.
A solar-powered navigation pylon whose mooring has drifted tens of thousands of kilometers off true station.
An unpressurized peripheral station housing the system cartographic archive and registry offices.

public_situation: The border between independent prospecting plots and {role:prospecting_consortium} leases has shifted outward, sparking protests at {role:survey_depot}.
private_truth: {role:disputed_beacon} was never anchored to bedrock, allowing thirty years of solar wind to push the legal boundary line directly into the independent miners' claim.

beats.public_change: {role:aging_cartographer} docks at the perimeter depot demanding an official calibration inspection.

missions.reason: He needs an unaligned pilot to scan the beacon's orbital telemetry and verify that its true position has drifted from the historical charter coordinates.
missions.private_fact: He missed the drift on his own survey twenty years ago and wants the error corrected before his professional license expires.

beats.public_change: {role:prospecting_consortium} files an emergency claim renewal, moving {role:conglomerate_escort} into the buffer zone.

missions.reason: He needs the sealed telemetry core delivered directly to {role:boundary_auditor} before consortium lobbyists petition to seal the public registry.
missions.private_fact: The consortium offered him a quiet retirement stipend this morning to drop the audit and leave the system.

beats.public_change: {role:conglomerate_escort} blocks departure lanes from {role:survey_depot}, hailing all traffic carrying telemetry archives.

missions.reason: The auditor needs the escort driven off so the registry decree can be broadcast without armed interference, and has no official security to call upon.
missions.private_fact: The gunboat captain offers to pay the pilot fifty thousand credits in mineral scrip to surrender the survey logs.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot delivers the true telemetry and repels the consortium gunboat.
resolutions.summary: {role:boundary_auditor} certifies the original boundary lines. {role:prospecting_consortium} is forced to surrender the encroached claims, restoring the independent miners' leases.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot proved the consortium's boundary beacon had drifted and broke their gunboat to enforce it.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot accepts the consortium escort's payout and hands over the telemetry logs.
resolutions.summary: {role:prospecting_consortium} destroys the drift records and cements their new boundary. {role:aging_cartographer} is dismissed as senile and loses his registry license.

consequences.public_summary: Word circulated that a pilot took consortium gold to bury forty years of stolen asteroid claims.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot abandons the contract, or drift measurements fail to verify.
resolutions.summary: Without verified outside telemetry, the old boundary markers are replaced. {role:prospecting_consortium} quietly absorbs the disputed plots into corporate leases.

loose_threads.detail: The mooring strut on {role:disputed_beacon} bears a maintenance serial issued to a freight logistics monopoly, not the system surveyor.
The title registry at {role:survey_depot} records five plot transfers signed by an official who died three months before the filing date.
The patrol roster at the depot lists security subsidies funded entirely by an anonymous debt holding company in an adjacent star system.

radio_hooks: Prospectors claim {role:disputed_beacon} wandered forty clicks while nobody was looking.
{role:prospecting_consortium} calls boundary complaints 'astronomical confusion by amateurs'.
Registry officials at {role:survey_depot} decline comment on pending claim appeals.

voice_direction.aging_cartographer: Speaks in measured, pedantic cadences with long technical pauses. Never raises his voice, even when describing thirty years of stolen mineral claims.
voice_direction.boundary_auditor: Rapid, defensive speech with frequent hedging clauses. Constantly cites filing sections and avoids stating who actually authorized the boundary update.
